Definition: from G1722 and φυσάω (to puff) (compare G5453); to blow at or on:--breathe on.
BiblicalUsage: One verse, and a great one: on Easter evening Jesus breathed on His disciples in John 20:22 and said, Receive ye the Holy Ghost — the risen Lord breathing new life into His people, as God once breathed life into Adam.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this breath is no symbol — the same Lord who breathed life into dust now breathes His Spirit into His church, and I live by that breath.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Appears to the Disciples on Easter Evening
